stem_book: A uniform solid spherical ball of mass M and radius R is projected along a rough horizontal surface (coefficient of kinetic friction μk) so that initially (t = 0) it slides with a linear speed v₀ but does not rotate. As it slides, it begins to spin and eventually rolls without slipping. How long does it take to begin rolling without slipping?
reason: print never names μk although the key is in terms of it; added 'uniform solid' and μk
work: v = v₀ − μkg t, ω = (5μkg/2R)t; v = ωR ⇒ v₀ = (7/2)μkg t ⇒ t₀ = 2v₀/(7μkg)
